exceptions.description: Published metadata says the model is a public dataset for informational use and provides warranty disclaimers, but does not explicitly grant modification and redistribution of converted runtime geometry.
exceptions.resolution: Obtain written approval from NYC OTI/DCP or counsel confirmation tied to the exact download and retain the decision as release evidence.

exceptions.description: The published model metadata does not state the payload CRS or vertical datum.
exceptions.resolution: Inspect CityGML envelopes and publisher metadata after approved acquisition; reject the source if EPSG and vertical datum cannot be resolved.

exceptions.description: The 3-D model represents the 2014 aerial survey and cannot establish current building existence by itself.
exceptions.resolution: Conflate by stable NYC identifiers and geometry; current OTI footprints control existence and footprint, while the 2014 model contributes roof form only when the match passes tolerance.

exceptions.description: The declared metro extent includes the Newark airport approach, which is outside NYC municipal source coverage.
exceptions.resolution: Use Overture and USGS sources for the approach shell; do not represent Newark as NYC-authoritative detail.

exceptions.description: No separately licensed models have been acquired for the Statue of Liberty, Empire State Building, Chrysler Building, One WTC, or named bridges.
exceptions.resolution: Use LoD2 official-model geometry only if rights are approved; otherwise acquire an exact licensed model or publish an explicitly labeled procedural proxy.

exceptions.description: Static GTFS redistribution in a derived immutable city package has not received human legal approval.
exceptions.resolution: Approve exact terms and snapshot, or derive a visibly labeled, non-schedule route graph from an already approved geospatial source.

exceptions.description: No 2560x1440 High-profile measurements exist from a named physical release GPU.
exceptions.resolution: Run the protected traversal suite on named hardware after final content is immutable; software rendering cannot satisfy this exception.
